source_title: NASA CR-166536, A Mathematical Model for Real Time Flight Simulation of a Generic Tilt-Rotor Aircraft
pdf_page_indexing: one-based page number, printed page tracked separately
data_role: Report model lookup tables; not raw independent experimental samples.
transcription_method: Manual visual transcription from original scanned pages, followed by page-wise and targeted source-cell checks.
source_rules: Table 5-I low Mach is the interval 0 to 0.2, not a collection of separate Mach samples.
Table 5-I printed columns are elevator 0,-10,-15,-20,+10,+15,+20 deg; CSV carries elevator angle explicitly.
Table 5-I has consecutive printed alpha knots -12 and +8 deg; no zero-angle or other intervening numeric records have been invented.
Table 5-II low Mach column directs the reader to Table 5-I for elevator=0 deg and alpha=-180..180 deg. Reference records retain empty values, not interpolated numbers.
Not Defined merged source regions are expanded only into explicit missing-status cells on the printed alpha/Mach grid; no zero filling or extrapolation.
Table 5-IV has no alpha or elevator axis and defines a correction shared by elevator and rudder.
No SI conversion is needed for the dimensionless coefficients; alpha/elevator axes retain degrees.
Interpolation policy and equations are outside digitization scope; source-referenced or interpolated values must not be relabelled as measurements.

source_anomalies_preserved.action: Both printed values retained; no imposed odd symmetry.
Both printed values retained; no imposed even symmetry.
